'''Blount''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the Alliance attacked the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] [[battle station]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> Blount served alongside [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] as a [[gunner]] in the quad [[laser]] turrets of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. With Blount onboard,<ref name="AEYNTK" /> [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] fired the shots from the [[pilot]]'s seat that destroyed the Death Star's [[reactor]] core and triggered the battle [[Space station|station's]] destruction.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blountincockpit.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Blount's brief appearance in the ''Millennium Falcon'' in ''Return of the Jedi'']]
Blount appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], standing in the cockpit of the ''Millennium Falcon'' just prior to the Battle of Endor.<ref name="ROTJ" /> He was portrayed by [[Trevor Butterfield]], who played a wide variety of roles in both ''Return of the Jedi'' and in [[1980]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strike Back'']].<ref name="Butterfield interview">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2012/10/trevor-butterfield-lieutenant-blount.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Trevor Butterfield interview - Lieutenant Blount - Star Wars}}</ref> Butterfield filmed additional scenes as Blount, running through the ''Falcon''{{'s}} corridors and manning the [[Starship|ship's]] quad turrets alongside General Cracken,<ref name="Blu-ray">Battle of Endor: The Lost Rebels (''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' deleted scene)—''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref> but they ultimately went unused in the film's final cut.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The rough, unedited footage was later included in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray Disc]] release of ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'',<ref name="Blu-ray" /> and both Blount and Cracken were confirmed as being the ship's gunners during the Battle of Endor in the [[2015]] book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK" />

The name "Blount" originates in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Canon|continuity]], as [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] christened Butterfield's Rebel character in its [[2000]] expansion set "[[Death Star II Limited]]."<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Blount}}</ref> The name was brought into current ''Star Wars'' canon with the release of ''Absolutely Everything You Need to Know''.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
